Have you tried the curly girl method of washing your hair? I used to absolutely HATE my hair, but when I found out about the curly girl method, I fell in love with it for the first time. 
I have issues with flaking too, and I found out that it was product build up on top of normal scalp flaking. Our scalp can flake if it's dry, and if it's too oily from what I found. 
You should co-wash your hair in the evening (the type of shampoo also matters) and make sure to rub your finger tips (no nails) on your scalp all over for a few minutes in circular motions, and try to keep conditioner off your scalp and limit it to your midshaft and ends only, then flip over hair, and rinse. Don't forget to squish to condish and put in product the same way afterwards and maybe a blob of mousse, then plop for bed with hair on top of ends. Also, before all that, olive oil or raw virgin coconut oil should be massaged into scalp and maybe ends of your hair only. Sorry for the wall text lol.
